notes: Canary traffic is raised 5% -> 25% -> 100% only after a clean 30-minute observation window. Any breach of a threshold in the window triggers an automatic rollback to the previous stable ReplicaSet, and the on-call follows docs/operations-runbook.md#o35--release-guard-and-rollback. The values are validated by frontend/lib/__tests__/releaseReadiness.test.ts and scripts/check-release-policy.mjs.
